verifier_notes: The packet's verifier field and work/verifier_strength.json disagree on roughly a quarter of shown candidates pool-wide, so I treated a candidate as FREE if either source says so and kept those out of final_top10. Nothing in my final ten is FREE under either. Two grades worth flagging: TerminalWorld tw_283245 is graded 'weak' (0.182), but the instruction pins the exact expected right-hand sides of all three lemmas and the task is decided by Agda's own type-checker, which cannot be faked - the grader's regex just cannot see that a type-checker is the oracle. The same applies to all seven Recursive-Task-Synthesis agda-tac tasks, which ship no verifier in our copy ('absent') yet are checked by Agda itself; I promoted two anyway because the theorem is identical to this TB2.1 task and said so here.

notes: This is the one task where the new corpora and the old pool both contribute something real, and the single most valuable find is in the OLD pool: Recursive-Task-Synthesis and TerminalWorld contain a cluster of eight near-identical tasks (seven rts_task_* plus tw_283245) that prove commutativity of natural-number addition by induction in Agda via agda-tac, with exactly the lemma1/lemma2/comm decomposition this Coq task needs. That is the closest content match in all 76,786 candidates, and lexical retrieval surfaced none of it in this packet - I found it by searching for 'Coq|Agda|proof assistant|theorem prover'. CalibForge supplies the only actual Coq tasks in the pool (three of them: software-engineering_*_019 at 20260422_235124, 20260501_172213 and 20260510_062946, all 'complete the proof, compile with coqc'), so the two new corpora do beat the old ones on domain exactness while the old ones win on theorem identity. Caveats for the merge step: (a) the seven agda-tac tasks are near-duplicates of each other, so taking more than two or three buys nothing - I ranked all seven in per_source because they genuinely are that corpus's best, but only promoted two; (b) they are all graded 'absent' because Recursive-Task-Synthesis ships no verifier in our copy, and tw_283245 is graded 'weak' - both are misleading, since Agda's type-checker decides them and cannot be satisfied by a fake; (c) TMax-15K has literally nothing formal - no proof assistant, no SMT, no type theory - so its whole list scores 1-2 and rank 10 is filler; SWE-Smith and SWE-Rebench likewise top out at overall 3 with grammar/type-inference bugs.
